requirements.quote:
The essence of the method is that the <mail-domain> is used as a domain
name to locate type MX RRs which list hosts willing to accept mail for
<mail-domain>, together with preference values which rank the hosts
according to an order specified by the administrators for <mail-domain>.
requirements.condition: When performing mail exchange binding for a mailbox.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the mailbox specification's <mail-domain> as the domain name for locating type MX resource records.
requirements.why_checkable: The domain name and record type supplied to the mail-routing DNS lookup can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Mail exchange binding uses the <mail-domain> part of a mailbox
specification to determine where mail should be sent.  The <local-part>
is not even consulted.
requirements.condition: When determining where mail should be sent using mail exchange binding.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Consult the mailbox specification's <local-part> to determine the mail exchange destination.
requirements.why_checkable: The destination selection inputs can be inspected, and different local parts with the same mail domain can be checked for identical mail exchange binding.

requirements.quote:
The essence of the method is that the <mail-domain> is used as a domain
name to locate type MX RRs which list hosts willing to accept mail for
<mail-domain>, together with preference values which rank the hosts
according to an order specified by the administrators for <mail-domain>.
requirements.condition: When interpreting MX resource records located for a <mail-domain>.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the listed hosts as mail exchanges willing to accept mail for that <mail-domain>.
requirements.why_checkable: The mapping from the queried mail domain to the exchange hosts represented by its MX records can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
The essence of the method is that the <mail-domain> is used as a domain
name to locate type MX RRs which list hosts willing to accept mail for
<mail-domain>, together with preference values which rank the hosts
according to an order specified by the administrators for <mail-domain>.
requirements.condition: When interpreting the preference values associated with hosts in MX resource records for a <mail-domain>.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the preference values as the ranking of those hosts according to the order specified by the administrators for that <mail-domain>.
requirements.why_checkable: The use of MX preference values in ranking exchange hosts can be inspected; this passage does not specify the numeric direction of preference.
